mfa_cancel: Cancel and return to sign in

mfa_first_admin_locked: The first administrator must keep two-factor authentication enabled.

mfa_status_disabled: Two-factor authentication is not enabled for this account.
mfa_status_enabled: Two-factor authentication is enabled for this account.
observability_rate_limits_empty: No rate-limit activity in the last 15 minutes.
protection_password_help: Minimum 4 characters. Replies inherit this protection automatically.
protection_password_keep_help: Leave blank to keep the current protection. Changing it applies to every reply in the thread.
reply_inherits_access: Replies inherit the thread's visibility, expiry and password protection.
reset_requested_sent: If an account exists for this address, a reset link has been sent.
trash_admin_intro: Deleted threads are retained before they are permanently purged. Storage counters stay charged until the purge.
trash_intro: Deleted threads stay here for a limited time. Restoring a thread brings every reply back.
trash_purge_expired_help: Deletes every thread older than the retention window. The current password is required.
trash_retention_notice: Threads are permanently removed after the retention period. Storage quota stays charged while a thread is in the trash.
unlock_intro: This entry requires a password. Enter it to view the thread.
visibility_help: Unlisted entries are reachable only by link. Private entries are visible to their author and administrators.
